items.title: Former Deepmind researcher thinks AlphaGo's playbook can cure AI hallucinations
items.summary: Former Deepmind researcher Thore Graepel wants his startup Metis Reasoning to bring AlphaGo's search principle to general reasoning. Instead of locking knowledge inside model weights, an explicit knowledge ledger would make every conclusion checkable against evidence. So far, though, there's no working system and no benchmarks. items.title: OpenAI asks outside experts, including a Nobel laureate, to check proofs its AI produced in math, computer science, and physics
items.summary: OpenAI says its internal AI models have cracked three major open questions in math, computer science, and physics. One of them is part of a famous Millennium Prize Problem, each of which carries a $1 million prize. Outside experts, including a Nobel laureate, are now checking whether the proofs hold up. items.summary: Anthropic says it will keep ads out of Claude. In a cover letter accompanying its IPO filing, the company argues that the chatbot's sole incentive should be to provide helpful answers. items.title: OpenAI's Ted Sanders shares a rule of thumb for picking the right GPT-model
items.summary: OpenAI's Ted Sanders explains where GPT-6.1 Terra fits in the company's GPT lineup. The smaller model outperforms the larger Astra in technical communication and costs far less but trails it in most other areas. Sanders says model size, reasoning effort, and multi-agent systems are distinct dimensions that can’t be reduced to a single "IQ score." items.title: GPT-6.1 Terra halves OpenAI's API prices and still gains ground on its larger models
items.summary: OpenAI has released GPT-6.1 Terra, a mid-range model that cuts API prices in half compared to its predecessor. Analysts say it sets a new standard for intelligence per dollar, especially for everyday computing tasks and AI-driven computer control. items.title: Anthropic opens its books for Wall Street, showing record revenue and mounting obligations
items.summary: Anthropic is the first major AI lab to file an S-1 with the SEC, planning to list on the Nasdaq under the ticker "ANT." The numbers are strong, with $11.6 billion in quarterly revenue, a first-ever operating profit, and existing customers spending nine times more year over year. items.title: Researchers find six patterns that make AI text so exhausting to read
items.summary: A study from New York University and the University of Texas at Austin shows that frontier language models systematically overuse linguistic patterns that are hard for humans to parse. The researchers trace the problem to training on code and math, where correctness gets rewarded but clarity doesn't. Smaller models, by contrast, write more like humans. items.title: Reddit's r/opensource bans all AI-related projects, sparking backlash and a rival subreddit
items.summary: The Reddit forum r/opensource has banned all posts about AI projects, whether built with AI, AI-powered, or designed for AI. Projects must also be at least a year old and have multiple contributors, and non-English posts are excluded as well. In response, the rival forum r/TrueOpenSource has already popped up. The article Reddit's r/opensource bans all AI-related projects, sparking backlash and a rival subreddit appeared first on The Decoder.
